updates.title: U.S. warns Gulf allies to prepare for a short, intense Iran campaign after the midterms, WSJ reports

updates.title: Mediators press Tehran for a deal as reports point to major U.S. strikes after Election Day

updates.title: Mediators press Tehran as the U.S. readies a week of strikes after the midterms

updates.title: Vance writes to Iran's security chief as U.S. forces prepare for possible strikes after the midterms

updates.title: U.S. strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Vance says no deadline for a deal

updates.title: A December Fed rate hike remains the base case as inflation stays at 3.7%

updates.title: Trump says he would 'do it again' on Iran as Qatari mediators wait for answers
updates.summary: Trump says the war was a factor in the losses but necessary, with no rush to resume strikes.

updates.title: Oil rebounds on Hormuz tanker worries as the Iran war becomes Congress's fight

updates.title: Oil swings on Iran diplomacy and tanker attacks as Democrats vow to end the war

updates.title: Analysts see high risk of renewed US-Iran fighting despite the Democratic sweep

updates.summary: Rubio called some Iranian demands outrageous, while Iran wants sanctions lifted before negotiating and oil prices slid.

updates.summary: Trump calls new strikes 'quite unlikely' while keeping the blockade, and Washington rejects Iran's 'outrageous' demands.

updates.title: Trump defends the Iran war on Veterans Day as Rubio says the U.S. will hold off on major strikes
updates.summary: Qatar-led mediation continues, Washington calls Iran's demands 'outrageous,' and the blockade stays in place.

updates.title: Iran talks stall as Trump says new strikes are unlikely and Rubio rejects Tehran's terms

updates.title: Trump says the U.S. doesn't need a deal with Iran, and oil rises

updates.title: Trump says the U.S. doesn't need an Iran deal, and Iran rules out nuclear inspections
updates.summary: Oil rose after Trump's post, and Tehran says inspections cannot resume under U.S. threats.

updates.title: Trump keeps the Iran blockade, saying no deal is needed, while Tehran rules out inspections

updates.title: Trump says no Iran deal is needed and keeps the blockade, while Tehran rules out inspections

updates.title: Trump says the U.S. needs no Iran deal and keeps the blockade, while Iran refuses inspections

updates.summary: The U.S. says it stopped two drones with no damage, while Trump's strategy is to wait and keep the pressure on.

updates.title: Iran fires drones at a U.S. radar in Bahrain again, and the U.S. strikes a missile site on Qeshm Island
updates.summary: CENTCOM says all drones were intercepted with no damage, while U.S. officials also weigh reports of an Iranian dirty-bomb plan against Washington.

updates.title: Iran fires drones at a U.S. radar in Bahrain again, ending a two-month lull
updates.summary: CENTCOM says the drones were intercepted without damage, while U.S. strikes on Qeshm Island have been reported.

updates.title: Thune weighs a lame-duck budget resolution to unlock $350 billion for the Pentagon
updates.summary: Trump wants a party-line package before Democrats take the Senate, but Republican votes look short.

updates.title: Senate Democrats split over tying Iran war limits to the Dec. 11 funding deadline

updates.title: Tankers struck near Hormuz as a third U.S. carrier arrives and Trump holds off on a decision
updates.summary: Trump told Axios he is not rushing a decision on Iran, while Netanyahu presses for a bombing campaign.

updates.title: Tankers keep getting hit near Hormuz as a third U.S. carrier joins the blockade
updates.summary: Attacks on shipping continue at about one a day, while oil still heads for a third weekly decline.

updates.title: Iran hits two more ships and widens attacks on U.S. sites in Kuwait as the blockade holds
updates.summary: Tanker attacks and strikes on U.S. air defenses continue, though not at the intensity of the war's early weeks.

updates.title: Iranian attacks on ships hit wartime highs as Tehran targets U.S. sites in Kuwait and Bahrain
updates.summary: Iran struck two ships in one day while the U.S. blockade holds, and October set a record for attacks on shipping.

updates.title: Iran widens attacks on Gulf neighbors as talks stall and U.S. keeps the blockade
updates.summary: Iran struck U.S. targets in Bahrain and Kuwait this week while Washington rejects Tehran's terms and keeps military pressure on.

updates.title: Iranian attacks on Hormuz shipping hit their highest level of the war while oil keeps falling
updates.summary: Tankers were struck Friday and Saturday and Iran hit a Kuwaiti air base, yet Brent is near $92 as Gulf exports recover.

updates.title: Oil slips on rising Middle East supply even as attacks on Gulf shipping continue
updates.summary: Brent fell about 2.8% Monday while the Houthis claimed a strike on a Saudi refinery and shipping was hit near Hormuz over the weekend.

updates.title: Oil edges lower as attacks on Gulf shipping continue and Iran says it is open to a deal
updates.summary: Brent fell slightly Monday on recovering Middle East exports, while mediators keep working on a possible ceasefire.

updates.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines as the U.S. widens sanctions and talks stay stalled
updates.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. escorts, while Washington sanctions more Iranian networks.

updates.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines under U.S. escort as Washington widens sanctions
updates.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. cover; Treasury sanctioned more than two dozen Iranian exchange houses.

updates.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines despite U.S. escort as attacks on Gulf shipping rise
updates.summary: The Revolutionary Guard claims mine strikes with no independent confirmation, while Treasury targets Iran's shadow banking network.

updates.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines as Treasury widens sanctions and Washington weighs leadership strikes
updates.summary: The Guard says three tankers hit mines despite U.S. escort, Treasury hit more shadow banking targets, and Fox News reports talks of striking Iran's leaders.

updates.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines despite U.S. escort as Treasury adds sanctions
updates.summary: The Revolutionary Guard claims three tankers were mined under U.S. cover; Washington has not confirmed.

updates.title: Iran says tankers keep hitting mines in Hormuz as the war enters its ninth month
updates.summary: The Revolutionary Guard says tankers struck mines under U.S. escort; Washington has not confirmed, and oil is back near $85.

updates.title: Senate control runs through Texas, Michigan and Ohio, with polls inside the margin of error

updates.title: Trump revives Iowa and Kansas rallies as CNN polls show Democrats ahead in Michigan and Texas
updates.summary: After canceling and then restoring two red-state rallies, Trump will appear in Dubuque and Salina on Sunday while Senate polling tightens.

updates.summary: Trump holds rallies in Dubuque and Salina on Sunday after cancelling and then reinstating them, with two days to go.

updates.summary: Forecasters give Democrats a strong edge in the House, while the Senate hinges on Alaska, Iowa, Maine, South Carolina, Texas and Michigan.

updates.title: Voters decide control of Congress as polls open, with Democrats favored in the House and the Senate in play
updates.summary: Democrats need three House seats and lead CNN's generic-ballot average by 9 points, while Fox rates the Senate a toss-up.

updates.title: Judge tosses Justice Department Alaska ballot suit as Trump hedges on accepting results and DOJ sends record monitors
updates.summary: The department will appeal the Alaska ruling to the 9th Circuit, and about 1,000 monitors are deployed in all 50 states.

updates.title: Polls close across the country with control of Congress undecided
updates.summary: Control of the House and Senate is at stake tonight, and NPR warns the Senate call could take much longer than the House.

updates.title: House Democrats weigh investigations first and impeachment later
updates.summary: Jeffries has not ruled impeachment in or out, and reporters say probes of Trump's businesses and immigration enforcement come first.

updates.title: Vance says the Iran war cost Republicans the midterms, and Trump calls that largely true

updates.title: Vance says the Iran war cost Republicans the midterms, and Trump partly agrees
updates.summary: Vice President Vance blamed the Iran war for the GOP rout, while Trump said Iran was part of it but defended the war.

updates.title: Democrats hold 54 Senate seats in NBC's count as Mississippi hangs on a few dozen votes

updates.title: Conservative writers blame Trump, the Iran war and affordability for the Republican rout

updates.title: Republicans argue over whether the Iran war or tariffs sank them in the midterms
updates.summary: NBC projects Democrats won both chambers, and conservatives are split between blaming the Iran war, tariffs and corruption.

updates.title: Democrats plan investigations and an affordability agenda, but face Trump's veto

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces Dec. 11 funding deadline as House GOP leadership scrambles

updates.summary: Republicans return after their midterm losses with a stopgap expiring Dec. 11, a defense bill and judicial nominees to clear before Democrats take over.

updates.title: Thune keeps Senate GOP leadership as Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline
updates.summary: Republicans re-elected Thune after a failed delay push, with a short-term spending bill widely expected before Democrats take over.

updates.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins the Mississippi Senate seat, lifting Democrats to at least 55 seats

updates.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat as Alaska stays uncalled

updates.summary: Alaska's official ranked-choice tabulation is set for Nov. 18, and analysts disagree on how transfers will break.

updates.summary: FISA expires Dec. 9 and funding Dec. 11, while Republicans debate who is to blame for the midterm losses.

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline as Trump's agenda stalls
updates.summary: Republicans hope for a stopgap into March while a $350 billion defense push and a weakened president complicate the agenda.

updates.title: Iran war funding sets up a shutdown fight before the Dec. 11 deadline

updates.title: Senate Democrats split over using the Dec. 11 funding deadline to force limits on the Iran war
updates.summary: Several Democrats say they will block any stopgap that does not restrict the war, while others warn a shutdown makes no sense.

updates.summary: PPIC has the tax at 46% yes and 52% no, and two countermeasures could cancel it even if it passes.

updates.summary: PPIC has the tax at 46% yes and 52% no, and UC Berkeley's IGS poll shows it down 42% to 50%.

updates.summary: BEA lifted Q3 growth to 4.3% from 3.4%; Trump called it a "RECORD SETTING ERROR" and demanded an investigation.

updates.title: U.S. proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China, the EU, Japan and India
updates.summary: USTR proposed Section 301 tariffs tied to alleged industrial overcapacity; China's would be 20%, and the levies could take effect as early as January.

updates.title: U.S. proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 trading partners, with China at 20%
updates.summary: USTR's proposal cites industrial overcapacity; rates run from 15% to 20%, with a comment period before any January start.

updates.title: U.S. proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 trading partners, with China at 20%
updates.summary: The proposed duties range from about 15% to 35% and need a public comment period; USTR says none take effect for a couple of months.

updates.title: U.S. proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 trading partners including China and the EU
updates.summary: The proposal sets mostly 15% to 20% rates; rates could fall for partners that sign trade deals, and nothing takes effect soon.

updates.title: U.S. proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 trading partners including China and the EU
updates.summary: Proposed rates run mostly 15% to 20%, but the comment process means nothing takes effect for a couple of months.

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline and a stalled GOP agenda
updates.summary: Congress has about five weeks to avoid a shutdown, and aides expect a stopgap through March or April.

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces Dec. 11 funding deadline as House GOP leadership scrambles
updates.summary: Republicans still run Congress until January, with a funding deadline, the defense bill and a farm bill ahead and Speaker Johnson's future unsettled.

updates.title: Thune keeps Senate GOP leadership as Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline
updates.summary: Republicans re-elected Thune after a failed delay push, with a short-term spending bill widely expected before Democrats take over.

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline and an Iran-war fight
updates.summary: Government funding runs out Dec. 11, and some Senate Democrats want Iran-war limits attached to any stopgap.

updates.title: Senate Democrats weigh using the Dec. 11 funding deadline to restrict Iran war spending
updates.summary: Kaine, Sanders, Van Hollen, Bennet and Duckworth want war limits in any stopgap, but a Senate bill needs about seven Democratic votes.

updates.title: Trump's lame-duck agenda stalls as Miller takes over the White House and Republicans trade blame
updates.summary: After the midterm losses, Stephen Miller replaced Susie Wiles, a Hegseth impeachment bid failed 211-204, and conservative writers blame Trump's treatment of Congress.

updates.title: Senate Democrats press for Iran war limits in the Dec. 11 funding bill
updates.summary: Several Democratic senators will oppose a stopgap that lacks language limiting Iran war spending, while Thune warns a rider could sink a deal.

updates.title: Senate Democrats split over tying Iran war limits to the Dec. 11 funding deadline
updates.summary: Four Democrats say they will oppose any stopgap without Iran war limits, while Thune calls the rider short-sighted and Republicans doubt a reconciliation route.

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline as Trump's agenda stalls
updates.summary: Republicans hope for a stopgap into March while a $350 billion defense push and a weakened president complicate the agenda.

updates.title: Democrats split over using the Dec. 11 funding deadline to force limits on the Iran war
updates.summary: Four senators say they will oppose a stopgap without war limits, while House Democrats avoid shutdown threats and Republicans warn of a holiday shutdown.

updates.title: Four Democratic senators say they will block a stopgap that lacks limits on the Iran war
updates.summary: Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline as Democrats split over using it to force Iran war limits and Republicans warn of a shutdown.

updates.title: Senate Democrats split over using the Dec. 11 funding deadline to force limits on the Iran war
updates.summary: Several Democrats say they will block any stopgap that does not restrict the war, while others warn a shutdown makes no sense.

updates.title: Iran war limits and a leadership vote hold up the December funding deal
updates.summary: Funding runs out Dec. 11 or 12, and several Senate Democrats say they will not back a stopgap without limits on the Iran war.

updates.title: Democrats split over tying Iran war limits to the December funding bill
updates.summary: Stopgap funding expires Dec. 11 as some Senate Democrats demand Iran war limits and Thune calls the ask unrealistic.

updates.title: Senate Democrats weigh Iran war limits as the Dec. 11 funding deadline nears
updates.summary: Congress returns Nov. 30 with 11 days to pass a stopgap, and Democrats are split on tying it to Iran war limits.

updates.title: Senate Democrats weigh Iran war limits as the Dec. 11 funding deadline nears
updates.summary: Congress returns Monday with 14 days to fund the government, and Democrats are split over tying Iran war limits to the stopgap.
